comparison.objective: Insert both ends of a lamp tube into sockets and rotate it to detent-lock; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-object dual-end alignment and coordinated tube rotation differ from concentric tool use and reaction-bearing jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Both pin pairs seated and detents engaged versus a 90° stop setting retained after three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both include rotational locking, but they test different objects, constraints, and abilities beyond geometry alone.
